reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #5 ('[Gitcoin GR11] Video Conference App for NKN') is a Gitcoin GR11 bounty/proposal listing, not an engineering defect or feature request against this repository. Its body asks solvers to 'integrate video conference functions to existing NKN clients (d-chat, nMobile). Or build a new app. Or port another video conference app to utilize NKN as the P2P network layer' and lists judging criteria (UI/UX, performance, demo over Zoom). It contains no reproduction steps, no failing test, no stack trace, no referenced source location, and no concrete change to nknorg/nBounty. Moreover the target repository has no code to change: default branch master at 776ec5cd0a191695e2153d38d256624cdb5d857a contains only README.md ('# nBounty / NKN bounty program') and .gitignore (a single commit 'add readme'), with no manifests, lockfiles, source, tests, or CI. This is therefore a grant/proposal request and generic product idea without a repository change, the class the delivery policy requires be blocked rather than converted into a fallback PR. Funding state: the Gitcoin bot already recorded 'Work for 7500.0 USDT has been submitted by' (https://gitcoin.co/issue/nknorg/nBounty/5/100026448) and maintainer yilunzhang replied the bounty was 'converted to long term bounty' (https://nkn.org/community/blog/nkn-gitcoin-gr-11-hackathon-winners-announced/), so no clean live engineering claim exists against this repo. Competition/PR check: the only PRs are #12 'Create blank.yml' (open, unrelated CI file) and #10 (closed, junk); no video-conference implementation PR targets nknorg/nBounty. Checkout left unchanged (no product edits; not checked out onto fix/bounty-5).
